n: Blue Robotics BlueSTEAM Ahead BlueROV2 curriculum
t: A free modular curriculum for teaching with the BlueROV2 underwater robot.
steps: Find the BlueSTEAM Ahead page on the Blue Robotics site.
Read the guide to choose between the BlueROV2 and the BlueBoat.
Contact Blue Robotics about education packages.
Plan a place to test the vehicle in water.
Prepare student devices for the control software.
Pilot one module before the full course.
